variants.headline: Fuel Your Workout with EcoSip
variants.body: Stay hydrated during every training session with the durable stainless steel body and reliable leak-resistant lid of the EcoSip Bottle. Designed for active lifestyles, this reusable bottle keeps up with your toughest routines.

variants.headline: Your Desk Companion for All-Day Hydration
variants.body: Power through your workday meetings and tasks with the sleek EcoSip Bottle. Featuring a sturdy stainless steel construction and a leak-resistant lid, it is the practical reusable choice for busy professionals.

variants.headline: Smart Hydration for Campus Life
variants.body: Carry your water securely from class to the library with the EcoSip Bottle. Its reusable design and dependable leak-resistant lid make it the ideal daily companion for students on the move.
